source_checks.result: Official store pages were used to verify the prefecture and municipality for all eight additions.

A local listing cites an official Instagram opening announcement for 2026-11-08 at Fukuoka-shi Chuo-ku Watanabe-dori 3-8-14. Direct retrieval of the Instagram account was blocked, so the item was not added pending direct official confirmation.
Both official notices still say the revised opening date is undecided; existing date-only records were preserved.

Green Cosmetic Garden, BAKERIES LAB. Shin-Yurigaoka, Gong cha Yumetown Saga, Hakata no Aji Yamaya, FLA-LAB, Pokemon Card Store Shizuoka PARCO, Perfumerie Sukiya Ichibancho, and La Prairie Hankyu Umeda were checked against latest.json; corresponding records were already present.
